topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: Well, wouldn't you know it! Mr. Johnson, the quiet chap next door, turns out to have more to his house than just the well-tended garden we all see. Turns out he's been enjoying the finer side of life for a while now, all under our noses. I guess that explains the occasional whiff of gourmet cooking that wafts over the fence and the curious gadgets he tinkers with in his garage. It's not every day you learn that your neighbor is a private jet enthusiast. I have to admit, there's a new sparkle to the street now that we know. Maybe I'll drop by, see if he's up for sharing some tips on those roses—he clearly has the green thumb to spare.
